title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: Dangerous-Goods Uplift That Stays Collectible on a Late Line
content:
## Clause

When a late demurrage line on a Demurrage and Detention Free Time record is cleared, its dangerous-goods uplift share is not cleared with it. The line passes that uplift on to the terminal, and it remains collectible from the billed party.

- **Dangerous-goods booking:** the share held back is the part of the amount still open that stands to the whole of it as the product's uplift percentage stands to 100 and that percentage together.
- **Any other cargo type:** the uplift share is nothing, and no part of the open amount is held back on this account.

## Points of judgement

- The share is taken on the amount still open, not on the amount first invoiced.
- The percentage is the one belonging to the product on the record.
- The cargo type is read from the booking under which the container moves.

## Illustration (hypothetical percentage)

Open amount 780.00, dangerous-goods booking, uplift assumed at 30 percent: the share kept collectible is thirty one-hundred-and-thirtieths of 780.00, which is 180.00.
